lines: Find the shortest distance from P(5, 2, 5) to the line r = (2, 0, 1) + λ(0, 1, 1).
solution: A general point on the line is F = (2, λ, 1 + λ).
The shortest distance has PF perpendicular to d: PF · d = 0.
This gives λ = 3, so F = (2, 3, 4) and PF = (−3, 1, −1).
